title: Add derived columns to a stream tibble — derive_columns
text: addcols_time(): Add cumulative elapsed time (seconds first point). addcols_distance(): Add cumulative distance (metres) geodesic point--point segments. device-reported dev_dist column present (TCX/FIT), also add dist_diff = dev_dist - distance QA. addcols_speed(): Add smoothed instantaneous speed (m/s), plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Speed centred moving average point--point diff(distance) / diff(time) window points either side. addcols_speed_naive(): Add naive average speed_ms (m/s) cumulative distance / time, plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Unsmoothed; running average start, instantaneous rate.

what: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: read_stream() reads single activity track file Strava bulk export returns tibble per-point stream data, dispatching file extension format-specific reader. GPX, TCX, FIT supported, including gzip-compressed (.gz) files shipped export. Fields given source provide dropped rather filled NA.

Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: path Path track file. extension (stripping .gz) must one gpx, tcx, fit.

title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: tibble one row per track point, drawn timestamp, lat, lng, altitude, heartrate, cadence, temp, dev_dist, velocity_smooth, watts, grade_smooth, plus "activity_metadata" attribute (see Details ).

title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: returned tibble also carries per-activity metadata attr(x, "activity_metadata"): flat named list elements format, source, sport (sports found, slash-joined), sub_sport, title, start_time, n_sessions, total_distance, total_timer_time, total_calories, NA anything source provide. intentionally flat (nesting) converts one-row table via tibble::as_tibble(). Subsetting many dplyr verbs drop attributes, persist deliberately.

title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: read_gpx_stream(): Read GPX file. Garmin TrackPointExtension fields (hr, cad, atemp) read via namespace-stripped XPath, GDAL extension flag required. read_tcx_stream(): Read TCX file. Strava's TCX exports carry leading whitespace <?xml> declaration, file read text trimmed parsing. read_fit_stream(): Read FIT file (requires FITfileR package). records() may return several tibbles file multiple record definitions; bound. Record fields vary files, safe getter returns NA absent fields. file record messages (e.g. workout definition) yields empty (0 x 0) stream.

title: Reorder stream columns into the canonical activity layout — relocate_activity_cols
text: Relocates whichever canonical stream columns present fixed order (axes, position, speed/pace, recorded sensors, device-reported channels, diagnostics). Uses dplyr::any_of(), absent columns skipped rather raising error, column canonical list kept, existing relative order, listed ones.
